# slendro

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tuningSystemSlendro`](gmeow-tuningSystemSlendro.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tuningSystemSlendro>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

A Javanese gamelan pentatonic tuning system; its exact intervals vary by instrument set and are defined relative to the host gamelan ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).
